name: Corisande, staff thrust
source: atk-corisande.png (recoloured with recolor-sprite.mjs --weapon), a 2 x 2 sheet split with split-sheet.mjs --grid; each frame sampled on a 1.76 px grid (twice as fine as its drawn pixels, as her other drawings are), so that she stands as tall as in her standing pose, and put on her masked palette; the glintstone pebble drawn ahead of the staff in frame 2 left out (the game looses its own); all frames cut to columns 24..397 and rows 9..297 of their 444 x 299 grids
